[EN] [Solo] The Missing Supplier
[ES] [Solo] El proveedor desaparecido
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Meren in Highwatch and gather information about the Supplier.
[ES] Habla con Meren en Highwatch y reúne información sobre el proveedor.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Tamarang and investigate Nimotz's Pegasus log.

[Press key to open inventory and right-click Island of Dawn Teleport Scroll to use.]
[ES] Ve a Tamarang e investiga el registro de Pegasos de Nimotz.

[Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y haz clic derecho en el pergamino de teletransporte de la Isla del Amanecer para usarlo.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] North Dock
[ES] Muelle Norte
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] There is luggage lying scattered on the ground. Those likely belong to Nimotz.
[ES] Hay equipaje esparcido por el suelo. Probablemente pertenezca a Nimotz.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Nimotz's belongings near the Dock.
[ES] Encuentra las pertenencias de Nimotz cerca del muelle.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Search Nimotz's belongings for clues to his whereabouts.
[ES] Busca pistas sobre el paradero de Nimotz en sus pertenencias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] North Dock
[ES] Muelle Norte
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] There is a note in Nimotz's belongings. You see the words 'Northern Overwatch.'
[ES] Hay una nota entre las pertenencias de Nimotz. Lees las palabras «Northern Overwatch».
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Note from Nimotz's Belongings
[ES] Nota de las pertenencias de Nimotz
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Nimotz in the Northern Overwatch area of the Island of Dawn.
[ES] Encuentra a Nimotz en la zona de Northern Overwatch en la Isla del Amanecer.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ovoliths's Web
[ES] Red de ovolitos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Basilisk Skin
[ES] Piel de basilisco
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Orisk Oil
[ES] Aceite de orisk
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather the materials and deliver them to Nimotz.
[Press key to open inventory and right-click the Personal Teleport Scroll: Nimotz.]
[ES] Reúne los materiales y entrégaselos a Nimotz.
[Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y haz clic derecho en el pergamino de teletransporte personal: Nimotz.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You obtained the Earth Stone.
[ES] Has conseguido la piedra de la tierra.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Earth Stone to empower the Eternal Crown. [Press key to open inventory and right-click the Earth Stone.]
[ES] Usa la piedra de la tierra para potenciar la corona eterna. [Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y haz clic derecho en la piedra de la tierra.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Meren in Highwatch.
[ES] Informa a Meren en Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
